level.setting: A decaying alchemical laboratory hidden beneath a ruined cathedral, filled with cursed reagents and long-dead experimenters.

enemy.name: The Shattered Philosopher
enemy.weakness: Tincture of Soulfire (player weapon)

encounters.hazard: Fumes of Despair – reduces player health by 10 upon entering the room.

pickup.name: Cursed Elixir
pickup.effect: Upon drinking, grants temporary resistance to poison but increases damage taken by 5 for 60 seconds.

encounters.trigger: Destroying the Shattered Philosopher releases a hidden lever that opens the path to the next room.

enemy.name: The Hollow Alchemist
enemy.weakness: Cursed Elixir (pickup from prior encounter)

encounters.hazard: Mirrors that reflect and amplify the player's pain, dealing 5% of max health damage per second.

pickup.name: Heart of the First Alchemist
pickup.effect: When used in conjunction with the Tincture of Soulfire, creates a powerful explosion that deals 30 damage to all enemies in a 5m radius.

encounters.trigger: Defeating the Hollow Alchemist causes the room to collapse, revealing the path to the final chamber.

enemy.name: The Alchemical Overmind
enemy.weakness: Heart of the First Alchemist (pickup from prior encounter)

encounters.hazard: The chamber periodically releases waves of alchemical energy that damage the player for 15 seconds at a time.

pickup.name: Philosopher's Legacy
pickup.effect: Upon completion of the level, permanently increases the player's maximum health by 20 and increases the potency of the Tincture of Soulfire by 50%.

encounters.trigger: The player must use the Heart of the First Alchemist in the final moment to trigger the explosion that defeats the boss.

boss.name: The Alchemical Overmind
boss.weakness: Heart of the First Alchemist (pickup from prior encounter)
boss.victory_condition: Player must use the Heart of the First Alchemist to trigger a final explosion, defeating the boss.

level.objective: Reach the heart of the laboratory and destroy the Alchemical Overmind, but beware of the cursed reagents and the remnants of the alchemist’s failed experiments.
level.reward: Philosopher's Legacy – boosts health and Tincture of Soulfire damage, marking the player as a true alchemical master.

level.setting: A desolate, blackened wasteland where the sun never rises and the air is thick with smoke. The ground is cracked and scorched, littered with charred remains of ancient creatures and burning shrines to long-dead gods. The only light comes from flickering embers and the faint glow of the player's fire magic.
level.player_weapon: Emberbrand - A torch infused with the fire of the Infernal Forge, capable of burning through the flesh and soul of the damned.

enemy.name: Ash Warden
enemy.weakness: Emberbrand's flame can burn through its charred shell, dealing 50% more damage.

encounters.hazard: Ash Cloud - A thick cloud of ashen dust that obscures vision and reduces movement speed by 50% for 5 seconds.

pickup.name: Infernal Ember
pickup.effect: When used with the Emberbrand, increases fire damage by 25% for 15 seconds.

encounters.trigger: The Ash Warden dies, revealing a hidden passage to the next area, and the Infernal Ember falls from its charred body.

enemy.name: Ash Serpent
enemy.weakness: The Infernal Ember, when placed on the ground, can ignite the Ash Serpent's body and cause it to explode.

encounters.hazard: Lava Pools - Pools of molten lava that deal 20 damage per second if stepped in.

pickup.name: Charred Rune
pickup.effect: When used with the Emberbrand, it summons a fiery spirit that attacks the enemy for 10 seconds.

encounters.trigger: The Ash Serpent dies, causing the ground to collapse and revealing the final chamber. A faint, pulsing glow signals the presence of the final boss.

enemy.name: The Ashborn Leviathan
enemy.weakness: The Charred Rune, when activated in the presence of the Infernal Ember, can unleash a fiery inferno that instantly kills the Leviathan.

encounters.hazard: Fissures of Fire - The floor cracks open periodically, releasing fireballs that deal 30 damage.

pickup.name: The Emberheart
pickup.effect: A legendary heart of fire, granting the player temporary invulnerability and boosting fire damage by 50% for 10 seconds.

encounters.trigger: Upon defeating the Ashborn Leviathan, the player must retrieve the Emberheart from its smoldering core to escape the level.

boss.name: The Ashborn Leviathan
boss.weakness: The Charred Rune, when activated with the Infernal Ember, creates a fiery explosion that shatters the Leviathan's core.
boss.victory_condition: Destroy the core while the Charred Rune and Infernal Ember are active.

level.objective: Escape the Ashen Wastes by surviving three brutal encounters and defeating the final boss, The Ashborn Leviathan.
level.reward: The Emberheart, granting temporary invulnerability and a 50% fire damage boost. Unlock access to the next level: The Ashen Citadel.

level.setting: An abandoned psychiatric hospital, partially consumed by a dark mist that seems to breathe and shift. The air is heavy with the scent of decay and forgotten screams.
level.player_weapon: Shattered Eclipse (a twin-bladed dagger that glows with unstable energy and can briefly reveal hidden pathways when swung at the right angle)

enemy.name: Crimson Wraith
enemy.weakness: Shattered Eclipse's energy blade

encounters.hazard: The hall is dimly lit, with flickering lights and the sound of whispers in the dark. The mist occasionally forms into the shape of a human figure before dissolving.

pickup.name: Echo Lens
pickup.effect: Allows the player to see through solid objects for a limited time, revealing hidden doors or enemies.

encounters.trigger: After defeating the Crimson Wraith, the Echo Lens activates, revealing a hidden passage behind a collapsed wall that leads to the next encounter.

enemy.name: Nightmare Nurse
enemy.weakness: Echo Lens (reveals the true form of the enemy, making it vulnerable for a short time)

encounters.hazard: The walls are lined with broken mirrors that occasionally reflect distorted images of the player. The air is thick with static and the faint sound of a heartbeat.

pickup.name: Soul Shard
pickup.effect: Restores 20% of the player's health and temporarily increases their damage by 10%.

encounters.trigger: Defeating the Nightmare Nurse triggers a psychic scream that awakens the final boss in the adjacent cellblock.

enemy.name: The Hollow One
enemy.weakness: Soul Shard (when used during the boss fight, it amplifies the Shattered Eclipse’s power, allowing the player to strike a critical blow)

encounters.hazard: The room is filled with rusted beds and shattered glass. The Hollow One emerges from the mist, its form shifting between human and monstrous. It emits a low growl that causes hallucinations and confusion.

pickup.name: Shroud of the Veil
pickup.effect: Grants temporary invisibility, allowing the player to evade attacks and strike from the shadows.

encounters.trigger: After the boss fight, the Shroud of the Veil is found in a hidden alcove, granting the player a crucial advantage for future encounters.

boss.name: The Hollow One
boss.weakness: Soul Shard (must be used in conjunction with Shattered Eclipse to deal critical damage)
boss.victory_condition: Defeat the Hollow One using the combined effects of the Shattered Eclipse and the Soul Shard, breaking its veil and freeing the trapped souls of the hospital.

level.objective: Navigate the haunted hospital, uncover the secrets hidden by the mist, and defeat the Hollow One to break the curse of the Hollow Veil.
level.reward: Shroud of the Veil (permanent invisibility ability) and a permanent damage boost from the Soul Shard.

level.setting: A desolate, ancient forest where the trees are gnarled and dead, and the air is thick with the scent of decay. The ground is littered with broken bones and the remnants of failed campfires.

enemy.name: Carrion Wraith
enemy.weakness: Shadow Bow

encounters.hazard: The ground cracks open, releasing a toxic mist that reduces player movement speed by 30% for 10 seconds.

pickup.name: Wraithbone Chisel
pickup.effect: Allows the player to dismantle the cursed bark of the trees, revealing hidden paths and weaknesses.

encounters.trigger: After defeating the Carrion Wraith, the mist clears, and a hidden path opens, revealing a glowing rune on the tree trunk.

enemy.name: Vinebound Sentinel
enemy.weakness: Wraithbone Chisel

encounters.hazard: The ground is covered in writhing vines that strike the player every 5 seconds, dealing 15 damage.

pickup.name: Runic Relic
pickup.effect: Grants the player a temporary immunity to the toxic mist and a 50% damage boost for 15 seconds.

encounters.trigger: After defeating the Sentinel, the vines retreat, and the rune on the tree glows brighter, leading to the final chamber.

enemy.name: The Hollow Guardian
enemy.weakness: Runic Relic

encounters.hazard: The chamber trembles with every attack, causing the player to take 10% of the damage dealt to the guardian as collateral.

pickup.name: Heart of the Grove
pickup.effect: Restores 100% of the player's health and grants a permanent 10% damage increase.

encounters.trigger: The guardian attacks relentlessly until the Runic Relic is used to reveal its true weakness. After its defeat, the Heart of the Grove is revealed.

boss.name: The Hollow Guardian
boss.victory_condition: Defeat the guardian using the Runic Relic to reveal its true weakness.

level.objective: Survive the desolate forest and defeat the guardian to uncover the secret of the Hollow Grove.
level.reward: Heart of the Grove and access to the next level, where the forest begins to heal.

level.setting: A desolate, overgrown cemetery at the edge of a forgotten village. The air is thick with fog, and the whispers of the dead echo through the tombs. The sky is dark, and the moon is obscured by clouds.
level.player_weapon: Soulbrand Dagger - A cursed blade that feeds on the essence of the dead. It pulses with a faint blue glow and can momentarily bind spirits to the physical realm.

enemy.name: Wraith of the First Burial
enemy.weakness: Soulbrand Dagger

encounters.hazard: The crypt walls begin to pulse with a strange energy as the wraith awakens. The air becomes colder, and the player must resist the pull of the wraith’s spectral touch.

pickup.name: Echoed Soulstone
pickup.effect: When used, this stone enhances the Soulbrand Dagger by 30% for 30 seconds.

encounters.trigger: After defeating the wraith, the tomb opens, revealing a hidden passage to the next encounter.

enemy.name: Carrion Warden
enemy.weakness: Echoed Soulstone

encounters.hazard: A decaying guardian of the dead, the Carrion Warden roams the chamber, wielding rusted chains that can bind the player in place.

pickup.name: Shattered Bell
pickup.effect: When used, this bell silences the warden’s howls, reducing incoming damage by 50% for 15 seconds.

encounters.trigger: After the warden falls, the ground cracks open, revealing a staircase leading to the final chamber.

enemy.name: The Hollow Sovereign
enemy.weakness: Echoed Soulstone

encounters.hazard: The Hollow Sovereign is a spectral ruler of the cemetery, surrounded by a ring of bound souls. Its presence causes hallucinations and fear, reducing the player’s accuracy.

pickup.name: Sovereign’s Core
pickup.effect: Absorbs the Hollow Sovereign's power, granting the player a temporary shield that blocks all damage for 30 seconds.

encounters.trigger: After the boss is defeated, the cemetery collapses, and the player escapes with the Sovereign’s Core, leaving the land forever still.

boss.name: The Hollow Sovereign
boss.victory_condition: Defeat the Hollow Sovereign by exploiting its weakness using the Echoed Soulstone acquired in the second encounter.

level.objective: Navigate the haunted cemetery, uncover the secrets of the dead, and defeat the Hollow Sovereign before it consumes the land.
level.reward: Sovereign’s Core - Grants temporary invulnerability, allowing the player to progress through tougher encounters.

level.setting: An abandoned cathedral, partially submerged in a flooded crypt, with flickering candles and warped religious iconography.

enemy.name: Cultist Warden
enemy.weakness: Chainsaw Axe (stuns the enemy, reducing damage taken by 50% for 3 seconds)

encounters.hazard: Crushing water pressure from the flooded crypt, reduces player movement speed by 30%.

pickup.name: Tainted Relic
pickup.effect: Increases Chainsaw Axe damage by 25%

encounters.trigger: Cultist Warden attacks the player, knocking over a crate of explosive barrels, which triggers the next encounter.

enemy.name: Spectral Choir
enemy.weakness: Tainted Relic (reduces spectral energy by 75% when used as a shield)

encounters.hazard: Echoes of the choir cause confusion, making the player take 50% more damage from all attacks for 5 seconds.

pickup.name: Soulbrand Vial
pickup.effect: Temporarily turns the player's attacks into soulfire, dealing 30% more damage and ignoring 30% of enemy defense.

encounters.trigger: Spectral Choir begins to chant, causing the stained glass window to shatter, revealing the final boss.

enemy.name: The Heretic High Priest
enemy.weakness: Soulbrand Vial (ignites the priest's ritual circle, causing massive area damage and staggering the priest for 8 seconds)

encounters.hazard: The priest's ritual creates a vortex of shadow and bone, reducing player health by 5% every second.

pickup.name: Cleansed Relic
pickup.effect: Restores 100% health and removes all debuffs upon pickup.

encounters.trigger: Defeating the High Priest causes the cathedral to collapse, triggering the final escape sequence.

boss.name: The Heretic High Priest
boss.weakness: Soulbrand Vial (must be used directly on the priest's ritual circle during his chant phase for maximum effect)
boss.victory_condition: Defeat the priest, escape the collapsing cathedral with the Cleansed Relic.

level.objective: Survive the chaotic horrors of the cathedral and defeat the Heretic High Priest to escape with the Cleansed Relic.
level.reward: Cleansed Relic, permanent 20% increase to Chainsaw Axe damage, and a new berserker ability: 'Frenzy of Souls' (unlocked via Soulbrand Vial).

level.setting: A decaying, abandoned psychiatric hospital located in a remote mountain valley. The air is thick with the scent of old blood and mildew. The silence is oppressive, broken only by the occasional creak of the floorboards or the distant whisper of wind through shattered windows.
level.player_weapon: Sonic Warden Baton (a non-lethal weapon that emits a low-frequency hum to disorient enemies)

enemy.name: Mirror Self
enemy.weakness: Sonic Warden Baton's frequency disrupts its reflective form

encounters.hazard: The walls are lined with cracked mirrors that distort the player’s reflection. Some mirrors show alternate versions of the player—distorted, angry, or silent—pulling the player into psychological unease.

pickup.name: Echo Lens
pickup.effect: Allows the player to see the true form of the enemy, bypassing illusions and mirages. Required for the boss fight.

encounters.trigger: After defeating the Mirror Self, the player finds the Echo Lens. The mirrors begin to crack and shatter, revealing a hidden passage leading deeper into the asylum.

enemy.name: Hollow Nun
enemy.weakness: The Echo Lens reveals her true form—a decaying, hollow shell that can be disrupted by the player’s sonic baton.

encounters.hazard: The room is filled with whispered voices echoing from unseen sources. The player must navigate a maze of pews and candle-lit alcoves while avoiding sudden lunges from the nun.

pickup.name: Chained Bible
pickup.effect: When used, it emits a calming pulse that temporarily halts enemy movement. Required for the final boss fight.

encounters.trigger: After defeating the Hollow Nun, the player retrieves the Chained Bible. The whispers grow louder and more urgent, leading to a hidden door at the end of the cloister.

enemy.name: The Warden's Shadow
enemy.weakness: The Chained Bible must be used to halt the boss's movements while the Sonic Warden Baton is used to disrupt its form. Only when both are used together can the player break the shadow’s hold.

encounters.hazard: The room is a circular chamber with a massive, cracked mirror at the center. The boss, The Warden's Shadow, is a towering, formless silhouette that mimics the player’s movements. The room is eerily calm, with a low humming sound that resonates with the player’s baton.

pickup.name: Warden’s Seal
pickup.effect: A permanent upgrade that allows the baton to disrupt spectral enemies indefinitely. Available after defeating the boss.

encounters.trigger: The Warden's Shadow appears as the final enemy, its form shifting in response to the player's actions. Only with the Chained Bible and Sonic Warden Baton can the player overcome it.

boss.name: The Warden's Shadow
boss.weakness: The Chained Bible must be used to temporarily halt the boss's movements, while the Sonic Warden Baton is used to disrupt its form. Only when used in tandem can the player break the shadow’s hold.
boss.victory_condition: Destroy the mirror core at the center of the room.

level.objective: Navigate through the asylum, uncovering hidden truths and overcoming spectral enemies, to confront and defeat the Warden’s Shadow. The key to victory lies in the items collected in prior encounters.
level.reward: Warden’s Seal (permanent upgrade to Sonic Warden Baton)

level.setting: A once-beloved toyshop now overgrown with strange, glowing flora and haunted by the laughter of unseen children.

enemy.name: Echo Puppet
enemy.weakness: Mirror of Echoes

encounters.hazard: A room filled with floating toy marionettes that mimic the player's movements, luring them into traps.

pickup.name: Shattered Bell
pickup.effect: When used, it causes nearby enemies to become confused for 3 turns.

encounters.trigger: Upon defeating the Echo Puppet, the bell begins to ring loudly, drawing attention from the next encounter.

enemy.name: Puppeteer's Shadow
enemy.weakness: Shattered Bell

encounters.hazard: The floor is covered with a dark, shifting mist that warps the player's perception of distance and direction.

pickup.name: Flickering Candle
pickup.effect: Lights the way through the mist and reveals hidden paths.

encounters.trigger: After the Puppeteer's Shadow is defeated, the mist clears, revealing a doorway with a glowing sigil that leads to the final chamber.

enemy.name: The Toy Architect
enemy.weakness: Flickering Candle

encounters.hazard: The room is filled with floating, animated toys that attack in waves, creating a chaotic environment.

pickup.name: Golden Key
pickup.effect: Unlocks the final treasure chest containing a permanent ability boost.

encounters.trigger: Upon defeating the Toy Architect, the room collapses into a final chamber, revealing a hidden treasure chest protected by the boss.

enemy.name: The Warden of Whimsy
enemy.weakness: Flickering Candle

encounters.hazard: The chamber is filled with ever-changing mirrors that reflect the player's fears, creating illusions that must be overcome to reach the boss.

pickup.name: The Mirror of Echoes (Reforged)
pickup.effect: Upgrades the player's weapon to its full potential, dealing 15 damage and allowing the player to reflect enemy attacks back at them.

encounters.trigger: After the final battle, the Warden vanishes, leaving only the reforged mirror and a path to the outside world.

boss.name: The Warden of Whimsy
boss.victory_condition: Destroy the Warden with the Flickering Candle while navigating through the illusionary mirrors.

level.objective: Navigate the toyshop, defeat the illusions and enemies, and escape with the reforged Mirror of Echoes.
level.reward: The Mirror of Echoes (Reforged), permanent ability boost from the Golden Key, and a new, whimsical horror map for future adventures.

level.setting: A sprawling underground clockwork refinery, riddled with leaking steam pipes, spinning gears, and malfunctioning automatons. The air is thick with oil, soot, and the occasional puff of pressurized vapor.
level.player_weapon: Clockwork Wrench (a tool that can jam gears and dislodge limbs with precise mechanical force)

enemy.name: Steamcore Automaton
enemy.weakness: Gears can be jammed with the Clockwork Wrench

encounters.hazard: Overheating machinery may explode, dealing area damage.

pickup.name: Pressure Valve Key
pickup.effect: Unlocks the pressure valves in the next area.

encounters.trigger: After defeating the automaton, the pressure valves in the next room begin to whirr, indicating the next encounter is imminent.

enemy.name: Goblin Tinker
enemy.weakness: The Pressure Valve Key can disrupt their steam-powered gadgets

encounters.hazard: Explosive steam tanks scattered across the room can be triggered by enemy attacks.

pickup.name: Broken Gear
pickup.effect: Can be used to repair the player's weapon temporarily.

encounters.trigger: Defeating the Goblin Tinker causes a steam vent to open, revealing the path to the final boss.

enemy.name: The Chronoguardian
enemy.weakness: The Broken Gear must be inserted into the boss's central mechanism to disable its time-based attacks.

encounters.hazard: The boss can summon smaller automatons if not defeated quickly.

pickup.name: Engineer's Badge
pickup.effect: Unlocks access to advanced repair tools in future levels.

encounters.trigger: Defeating the Chronoguardian unlocks the final valve, allowing steam to fully flow through the refinery.

boss.name: The Chronoguardian
boss.weakness: The Broken Gear must be inserted into the boss's core to disable its time-based attacks.
boss.victory_condition: Defeat the Chronoguardian with the Broken Gear in hand.

level.objective: Restore power to the central reactor by navigating the refinery and disabling the rogue automatons that are sabotaging it.
level.reward: Engineer's Badge and access to the next level's advanced tools.

level.setting: The Forgotten Clockworks of Aetherhold — a once-thriving city of steam and invention, now abandoned and overrun by rogue automatons and shadowy figures.
level.player_weapon: Aetheric Gauntlet (a weapon that manipulates kinetic energy and can overload mechanical systems if charged properly)

enemy.name: Clockwork Warden
enemy.weakness: Overloaded mechanical joints (can be damaged by the Aetheric Gauntlet if charged for 3 seconds and fired at the right angle)

encounters.hazard: A shifting floor of interlocking gears that can trap the player if not navigated carefully.

pickup.name: Aetheric Capacitor
pickup.effect: Allows the Aetheric Gauntlet to be charged for 1 extra second, increasing its overload damage.

encounters.trigger: Defeating the Warden unlocks the sealed door to the next area by aligning the gears in the room.

enemy.name: Ironclad Sentinel
enemy.weakness: Exposed pressure valves (can be damaged by the Aetheric Capacitor if used as a projectile, detonating the Sentinel's internal steam system)

encounters.hazard: Steam vents that burst periodically, causing area damage and obscuring vision.

pickup.name: Chrono-Cog
pickup.effect: Allows the player to slow down time for 3 seconds, increasing damage dealt by 50%.

encounters.trigger: Destroying the Sentinel's pressure valves causes a steam explosion that triggers a hidden lever, revealing the path to the final chamber.

enemy.name: The Mechanarch
enemy.weakness: The Aetheric Core (must be damaged using the Aetheric Capacitor, which was picked up in the previous encounter, in conjunction with the Aetheric Gauntlet)

encounters.hazard: Periodic bursts of unstable energy that reduce the player's health and temporarily disable the Aetheric Gauntlet.

pickup.name: Aetheric Core Key
pickup.effect: Unlocks the Mechanarch’s heart, allowing for a final devastating blow.

encounters.trigger: The player must navigate the energy bursts and use the Aetheric Capacitor to overload the Mechanarch’s core, which requires both the capacitor and the charged Aetheric Gauntlet.

boss.name: The Mechanarch
boss.weakness: The Aetheric Core (must be damaged using the Aetheric Capacitor, which was picked up in the previous encounter, in conjunction with the Aetheric Gauntlet).
boss.victory_condition: Destroy the Aetheric Core with the Aetheric Capacitor and the charged Gauntlet to defeat the boss.

level.objective: Reach the Aetheric Core, defeat the Mechanarch, and restore power to the city's central engine.
level.reward: Aetheric Core Key (unlocks advanced blueprints for future Aetheric Gauntlet upgrades)

level.setting: A floating island city called Gearsprout, where steam-powered automatons and clockwork beasts roam among lush, mechanical gardens.

enemy.name: Glimmerbug
enemy.weakness: Arcane Flask (apply alchemical fire)

encounters.hazard: Steam vents erupt randomly, reducing player movement by 1 space.

pickup.name: Steam Condenser
pickup.effect: When used, grants a shield of 3 for 1 turn.

encounters.trigger: Glimmerbug’s defeat causes a nearby automaton to awaken, leading the player to the next area.

enemy.name: Clockwork Skitter
enemy.weakness: Steam Condenser (deactivate the automaton's core)

encounters.hazard: Moving through the plaza causes a temporary fog that obscures line of sight.

pickup.name: Alchemical Catalyst
pickup.effect: When used, increases Arcane Flask damage by 2 for 3 turns.

encounters.trigger: Destroying Clockwork Skitter causes the plaza's central tower to rise, revealing the final boss.

enemy.name: Lord Chronos the Iron
enemy.weakness: Alchemical Catalyst (accelerates the alchemical reaction in the flask)

encounters.hazard: Periodic clockwork explosions that deal 2 damage to the player if standing in the blast radius.

pickup.name: Chronos' Gear
pickup.effect: When used, grants 10 temporary health and restores 5 mana.

encounters.trigger: Player must combine the Steam Condenser, Alchemical Catalyst, and Arcane Flask in a final alchemical reaction to weaken Lord Chronos.

boss.name: Lord Chronos the Iron
boss.weakness: Alchemical Catalyst (must be used with Arcane Flask to trigger a reaction that bypasses Lord Chronos’ armor)
boss.victory_condition: Player must use the Alchemical Catalyst to amplify the Arcane Flask's fire, causing a chain reaction that breaks Lord Chronos’ core.

level.objective: Defeat Lord Chronos the Iron by using the alchemical tools gathered during your journey through Gearsprout.
level.reward: A key to the next level, a full mana restore, and a new alchemical recipe.

level.player_weapon: Gilded Needle (a modified syringe with poison-laced steam)

enemy.name: Steam-Infused Automaton
enemy.weakness: Gilded Needle's poison infusion

encounters.hazard: Steam vents erupt with pressure, dealing 5 damage per second if player lingers too long.

pickup.name: Oiled Gear
pickup.effect: Reduces weapon overheating by 30% for the duration of the level.

encounters.trigger: The automaton's destruction releases a pressure valve, flooding the next chamber with oil.

enemy.name: Sludge Warden
enemy.weakness: Oiled Gear (increased damage when weapon is oiled)

encounters.hazard: Sludge accumulates on the floor, reducing movement speed and increasing damage from traps.

pickup.name: Chrono Catalyst
pickup.effect: Increases player movement speed by 20% and allows temporary time slowdown.

encounters.trigger: The Warden's defeat causes a hidden time vault door to open, leading to the final chamber.

enemy.name: The Chrono Mechanic
enemy.weakness: Chrono Catalyst (enables time slowdown to land critical hits)

encounters.hazard: The room is filled with shifting gears and time distortions that cause random weapon malfunctions.

pickup.name: The Time-locked Key
pickup.effect: Unlocks a secret exit or reveals hidden loot after the level.

encounters.trigger: Defeating the Chrono Mechanic releases a burst of steam that triggers the exit, ending the level.

boss.name: The Chrono Mechanic
boss.weakness: Chrono Catalyst (enables time slowdown to land critical hits)
boss.victory_condition: Defeat the boss without taking more than 40 damage.

level.objective: Escape the catacombs before the time lock resets the entire facility.
level.reward: Access to the upper levels of Ironveil and a rare blueprint for a new rogue weapon.

level.setting: The Iron Maw of Aetherhold — a derelict airship graveyard suspended over the storm-wracked skies of a dying continent.
level.player_weapon: The Tempest Rod — a conduit of arcane lightning, capable of channeling storm energy into devastating blasts.

enemy.name: Ironclad Warden
enemy.weakness: The Tempest Rod's lightning discharges short-circuit its internal mechanisms.

encounters.hazard: Storm-Induced Overload

pickup.name: Aether Capacitor
pickup.effect: Increases Tempest Rod damage by 20% and allows temporary shielding from electrical hazards.

encounters.trigger: The Warden's death releases a surge of unstable energy, causing nearby machines to activate.

enemy.name: Golem Butcher
enemy.weakness: The Aether Capacitor’s energy field disrupts its mechanical joints.

encounters.hazard: Clawed Blades of Steel

pickup.name: Storm Core
pickup.effect: Allows the Tempest Rod to fire a charged, area-of-effect bolt once per encounter.

encounters.trigger: The Butcher's destruction causes the airship's main engine to awaken — signaling the approach of the final boss.

encounters.location: The Heart of the Iron Maw

enemy.name: Skybound Leviathan
enemy.weakness: The Storm Core must be implanted into the Leviathan's core to overload its power systems.

encounters.hazard: Tremors, electrical storms, and collapsing deck plating.

pickup.name: Void Anchor
pickup.effect: Stabilizes the player's stance during intense combat, reducing falling damage and increasing movement speed.

encounters.trigger: The Leviathan's defeat causes the airship to collapse into the storm below — the player must escape to the skies.

boss.name: The Skybound Leviathan
boss.weakness: The Storm Core must be implanted into its core to overload its power systems, causing a massive explosion that can be controlled by the player.
boss.victory_condition: Defeat the Leviathan by overloading its core with the Storm Core, then escape the collapsing airship.

level.objective: Survive the collapsing airship graveyard, defeat three foes, and destroy the Leviathan by using pickups from prior encounters to exploit its weakness.
level.reward: Access to the Skyborne Citadel, a hidden steampunk fortress above the clouds.

level.setting: A desolate, fog-shrouded industrial district in a forgotten city, where time has broken and machinery runs on unstable energy. The air is thick with rust, steam, and the echoes of the past.
level.player_weapon: Chrono Gauntlet: a device that manipulates time in localized pockets, allowing the player to slow, rewind, or pause time for brief moments.

enemy.name: Steam Wraith
enemy.weakness: Chrono Gauntlet - Time Slow Effect

encounters.hazard: The tower occasionally emits unstable time bursts, causing the player to experience brief time loops if not careful.

pickup.name: Fused Chrono Crystal
pickup.effect: Boosts Chrono Gauntlet's time manipulation range by 50%

encounters.trigger: As the player defeats the Steam Wraith, the crystal activates, causing the tower's gears to shift, unlocking the path to the next area.

enemy.name: Tinker Automaton
enemy.weakness: Fused Chrono Crystal (pickup from previous encounter) - Time Rewind Effect

encounters.hazard: The floor is littered with mechanical traps that activate upon the player's movement.

pickup.name: Gears of Time
pickup.effect: Reduces the cooldown of the Chrono Gauntlet's rewind ability to 5 seconds.

encounters.trigger: After defeating the automaton, the gears begin to rotate, aligning a hidden portal to the final chamber.

enemy.name: The Chrono Warden
enemy.weakness: Gears of Time (pickup from second encounter) - Time Rewind + Chrono Gauntlet's Pause Effect

encounters.hazard: The Warden controls time itself, causing the player to experience flashbacks of past encounters and random time skips.

pickup.name: Temporal Anchor
pickup.effect: Permanently increases the player's health by 20 and reduces damage taken by 10%.

encounters.trigger: Upon defeating the Warden, the player is transported to a new, uncharted region of time where they can choose their next path.

boss.name: The Chrono Warden
boss.weakness: Gears of Time (pickup from second encounter) - Time Rewind + Chrono Gauntlet's Pause Effect
boss.victory_condition: Defeat the Chrono Warden by exploiting the weakness provided by the Gears of Time, while navigating his time-based attacks.

level.objective: Navigate the broken time machines and defeat the Chrono Warden to restore order to the fractured timeline.
level.reward: Temporal Anchor - A device that stabilizes time, granting the player increased health and damage resistance.

level.setting: A derelict, clockwork-powered fortress buried beneath the misty ruins of an ancient city, where time seems to move erratically due to unstable alchemical core mechanisms.

encounters.location: The Gears of Time - First Chamber

enemy.name: Ironbound Chronomancer
enemy.weakness: The Chrono Rod's time-rewind ability

encounters.hazard: The chamber is filled with time-slowing vapor that reduces player movement speed by 30%

pickup.name: Fused Core Fragment
pickup.effect: Increases Chrono Rod's damage by +10 when used in a time-rewind

encounters.trigger: Defeating the Ironbound Chronomancer causes a nearby clock to fall from the ceiling and unlock the next chamber.

enemy.name: Tanglevein Automaton
enemy.weakness: The 'Fused Core Fragment' pickup from the previous encounter

encounters.hazard: Moving through the garden triggers mechanical vines that entangle the player, increasing damage taken by 25% for 5 seconds

pickup.name: Cursed Gear Oil
pickup.effect: When applied to the Chrono Rod, it increases its time-rewind range by 50% (max 15 seconds).

encounters.trigger: The Tanglevein Automaton's defeat triggers a massive mechanical door to open, revealing the final chamber.

enemy.name: The Timebound Warden
enemy.weakness: The 'Cursed Gear Oil' pickup from the second encounter

encounters.hazard: The chamber's core emits a powerful time-distortion field that randomly rewinds player actions or skips ahead 2 seconds, making combat unpredictable.

pickup.name: Timekeeper's Seal
pickup.effect: Temporarily halts time for 5 seconds when activated, allowing the player to reposition or heal.

encounters.trigger: After the final fight, the player is transported back to the first chamber with all pickups retained, revealing the fortress has reset, forcing a repeat of the level.

boss.name: The Timebound Warden
boss.weakness: The 'Cursed Gear Oil' pickup from the second encounter
boss.victory_condition: Defeat the Warden while using the Cursed Gear Oil on the Chrono Rod to fully utilize its time-rewind capabilities.

level.objective: Navigate through the three chambers, defeat the enemies, and use the pickups to unlock the final boss fight with the Timebound Warden.
level.reward: Access to the 'Chrono Overlord' title and the 'Timekeeper's Seal' as a permanent item for future levels.

level.setting: A serene, overgrown steampunk garden with intricate brass gears, floating lanterns, and a clock tower that hums softly in the background.

enemy.name: Iron Thistle
enemy.weakness: The Gilded Mace

encounters.hazard: The ground is littered with broken cogs that slow movement by 20%

pickup.name: Clockwork Seed
pickup.effect: Increases the player's weapon damage by +2 for 3 encounters.

encounters.trigger: The Iron Thistle falls, causing a gear to roll away, revealing a hidden path toward the garden's center.

enemy.name: Steam Vixen
enemy.weakness: Clockwork Seed (from previous encounter)

encounters.hazard: The air is thick with steam, reducing accuracy by 15% if not protected by a shield.

pickup.name: Lantern Oil
pickup.effect: Restores 25% of the player's health and increases movement speed for 2 turns.

encounters.trigger: Defeating the Steam Vixen causes the central clock tower to begin ticking loudly, signaling the arrival of the final guardian.

enemy.name: The Chrono Sentinel
enemy.weakness: Lantern Oil (from second encounter)

encounters.hazard: The clock tower's gears create wind bursts that can knock the player back.

pickup.name: Clockwork Heart
pickup.effect: Unlocks a new ability: 'Time's Blessing'—a shield that lasts for 3 turns.

encounters.trigger: The Chrono Sentinel is defeated, and the tower stops, revealing a glowing portal to the next level.

boss.name: The Keeper of the Garden
boss.victory_condition: Defeat the Keeper and absorb the Clockwork Heart to unlock the next level.

level.objective: Protect the garden's heart from corrupted machines and restore balance through the power of the Clockwork Seed and Lantern Oil.
level.reward: The Clockwork Heart, granting the player the ability to harness time in battle.
